coefficient_cost_audit.scope: Fixed six-expert shared_z pilot; coefficient/capacity and native-routing exposure only.

static_cost.precision: One byte per canonical W8 coefficient; F32 complete-row scales and F32 readout biases. Non-FFN tensors retain source GGUF bytes. No AiF page padding or ECC is assumed.

host_residency.interpretation: Shared GU/D already belong to the checkpoint; residency moves these weights rather than creating them. If the host budget can hold shared GU plus all six C matrices, the strongest same-representation control keeps C on host and pays no C flash reads. All C are not free under a budget that only fits shared GU. Biases/scales are included; KV, activations, workspace and allocator overhead need additional host capacity.

full_model_weight_accounting.functional_harness_note: The current quality harness loads the complete original GGUF, builds native W8 caches, and adds readouts. Reported removal savings describe a possible tensor conversion after quality eligibility is accepted, not measured process RSS or a smaller GGUF already created.
exclusions: runtime metadata beyond row scales and biases

hypothetical_all64_all26_NOT_VALIDATED.interpretation: Arithmetic extrapolation only. The pilot measures six fixed experts across three layers, so it cannot support this all-expert/all-layer conversion.

native_TEST_exposure.source: Native W8 capture routing, teacher-forced first 16 tokens. This is a workload diagnostic, not post-replacement routing or timing.
native_TEST_exposure.uncaptured_alpha_limitation: Only three layers store router alpha. The full-model execution-slot denominator is known (26 x 6 per token), but full-model alpha-weighted exposure is unavailable and is not extrapolated.
native_TEST_exposure.timing_limitation: Coefficient work counts assume selected native FFNs read once without caching and omit shared work, host GU, dependencies, row scales/biases, transfer, control and overlap. They are not speedups.

limitations: 16-token English WikiText paragraph starts; 61 correlated article clusters, not long-context/multitask accuracy or standard benchmark PPL.
Only six fixed experts in raw layers1,13,26 are replaced; other experts/layers and the native shared branch remain active.
Native reference is canonical FFN row-W8/vector-A8 over a Q8_0 GGUF checkpoint, not BF16 or bit-identical original GGUF inference.
FP readouts use a separate declared diagnostic accumulation contract; only W8A8 readouts enter live quality arms.
Functional harness still computes original FFN and duplicates shared-GU verification; wall times are not compressed deployment performance.
Eight greedy tokens measure early divergence only; sequence agreement is not answer correctness.
NLL exposure counts prefill positions0..14 only; final prefill and final unused decode are listed separately.
Secondary intervals are descriptive, individually95%; primary quality endpoint is shared_vs_native only.
No actual flash reads, NVMeVirt latency, complete-model speedup or novelty claim is established by these experiments.
